patterns.note: The homepage features a full-bleed dark background with a large, centered hero text and an immersive product screenshot as the dominant visual element.

A single, modern sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with significant variations in size and weight to establish a clear visual hierarchy, from an oversized, bold hero headline to smaller, lighter body text.
A high-contrast dark mode palette (near-black background, white text) is consistently applied, with a single vibrant orange reserved for calls to action and key interactive elements.
The page content scrolls as a single, unified block; there are no scroll-triggered animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements observed as the user scrolls down.
The homepage is structured as a single, tall hero section that immediately presents the core product and its value proposition, without breaking into distinct content blocks or feature sections.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a deep charcoal background and high-contrast white text, using a single vibrant orange for interactive elements and brand accents.

Typography relies on a single sans-serif font family, leveraging significant variations in size and weight to create a strong visual hierarchy, from an oversized, bold hero headline to smaller, lighter body text.
The primary visual is a large, detailed product screenshot, presented within a subtle, rounded frame, which scrolls naturally with the page content without any special motion effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold hero heading (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy down to small, light body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle, consistent rounding on interactive elements and product visuals.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero section with generous vertical spacing, transitioning to a more balanced density in the footer.

standout: The immediate impact of the oversized, bold headline 'It's about time.' combined with the immersive, dark-mode product screenshot creates a powerful, almost cinematic introduction. The design is distinctive for its confidence in a minimal, single-section hero that relies entirely on strong typography and a detailed product visual to convey its message, rather than a multi-section layout or complex animations.
